title: ProgressIndicator
description: Indicates progress: an indeterminate progressbar drawn as a spinner, circle, wave, bar or dotted bar, or — with value — a determinate bar or circle.

props.name: color
props.description:
Semantic color of the indicator: theme primary, neutral gray or a status
color (success / warning / danger / info). "current" is a special value
that follows the surrounding text color (currentColor), e.g. inside
buttons or colored containers

props.name: value
props.description:
Current progress. Setting it switches the bar and circle variants to
determinate mode (a filled bar / arc and aria-valuenow); the value is
clamped between 0 and max. Other variants ignore it and stay
indeterminate.

props.name: max
props.description:
Value that represents completion (determinate mode only); non-positive
values fall back to 100

props.name: showValue
props.description:
Shows the formatted value (a percentage by default) next to a
determinate indicator

props.name: format
props.description:
Formats the value shown by showValue (or use the `value` slot); the
result is also used as aria-valuetext

props.name: label
props.description:
Visible text shown next to the indicator (or the `label` slot); it also
names the progressbar unless aria-label is set

props.name: decorative
props.description:
Purely visual: drops the progressbar role and hides the indicator from
assistive technologies. Use it when a surrounding element (a status
region, a busy button) already conveys the loading state.

props.name: width
props.description:
Custom width (ignored when full is set). Bars default to 200px; round
indicators size to their content.

props.name: full
props.description: Stretches the indicator to the full width of its container

slots.name: value
slots.description: Custom rendering of the shown value (showValue)

vars.name: --progress-width
vars.description: Width of a linear indicator with the default width

vars.name: --progress-track-color
vars.description: Color of the bar track (and of the determinate circle track)

vars.name: --progress-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the bar track (defaults to --radius-sm)

vars.name: --progress-size
vars.description: Size of the round indicators (spinner / circle / wave; every size)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Button, HStack, ProgressIndicator, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";

const lessons = ref(2);
const format = (value: number, max: number) => `${value} / ${max}`;
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" align="stretch">
    <ProgressIndicator
      variant="bar"
      full
      :value="lessons"
      :max="5"
      show-value
      :format="format"
      label="Lessons completed"
    />
    <HStack :gap="4" wrap align="center">
      <ProgressIndicator
        variant="circle"
        size="xlarge"
        :value="(lessons / 5) * 100"
        show-value
        aria-label="Course progress"
      />
      <ProgressIndicator
        variant="bar"
        color="success"
        :value="100"
        show-value
        aria-label="Done"
      />
      <ProgressIndicator
        variant="bar"
        color="danger"
        :value="15"
        show-value
        aria-label="Overdue"
      />
    </HStack>
    <HStack :gap="2">
      <Button
        size="small"
        variant="outline"
        :disabled="lessons === 0"
        @click="lessons = Math.max(0, lessons - 1)"
        >Undo lesson</Button
      >
      <Button
        size="small"
        :disabled="lessons === 5"
        @click="lessons = Math.min(5, lessons + 1)"
        >Complete lesson</Button
      >
    </HStack>
  </VStack>
</template>

translationResources.title: ProgressIndicator
translationResources.description: Indicates progress: an indeterminate progressbar drawn as a spinner, circle, wave, bar or dotted bar, or — with value — a determinate bar or circle.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant picks the style: spinner (default), circle, wave, bar or dotted bar.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Five sizes from xsmall to xlarge: the diameter of round indicators or the thickness of bars.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Semantic color: primary (default), neutral or a status color (success, warning, danger, info); the special value current follows the surrounding text color (currentColor), e.g. inside buttons.

label.title: Visible label
label.description: A visible label sits next to the indicator and names the progressbar.

width.title: Width
width.description: Set a fixed width, or use full to fill the container.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: Show an icon before the indicator. Always describe what is loading with aria-label.

determinate.title: Determinate
determinate.description: Set value (and optionally max) to fill the bar or the circle and expose aria-valuenow; showValue prints a percentage, format customizes it. Status colors (success, warning, danger, info) convey state. Other variants ignore value.

ProgressIndicatorProps.color: Semantic color of the indicator: theme primary, neutral gray or a status color (success, warning, danger, info). The special value current follows the surrounding text color (currentColor)
ProgressIndicatorProps.value: Current progress: switches the bar and circle variants to determinate mode (a filled bar / arc and aria-valuenow), clamped between 0 and max. Other variants ignore it
ProgressIndicatorProps.max: Value that represents completion (non-positive values fall back to 100)
ProgressIndicatorProps.showValue: Shows the formatted value (a percentage by default) next to a determinate indicator
ProgressIndicatorProps.format: Formats the value shown by showValue; a string or number result is also used as aria-valuetext
ProgressIndicatorProps.label: Visible text shown next to the indicator; it also names the progressbar unless aria-label is set
ProgressIndicatorProps.aria-label: Accessible label describing what is loading (default "Loading", or "Progress" in determinate mode)
ProgressIndicatorProps.decorative: Purely visual: drops the progressbar role and hides the indicator from assistive technologies
ProgressIndicatorProps.width: Custom width (ignored when full is set); bars default to 200px
ProgressIndicatorProps.full: Stretches the indicator to the full width of its container

cssVars.--progress-width: Width of a linear indicator with the default width
cssVars.--progress-track-color: Color of the bar track (and of the determinate circle track)
cssVars.--progress-radius: Corner radius of the bar track (defaults to --radius-sm)
cssVars.--progress-size: Size of the round indicators (spinner / circle / wave; every size)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Five indeterminate indicators. Each is a progressbar named by its label or the localized "Loading".

sizes-colors.title: Sizes and colors
sizes-colors.description: Five sizes; color="current" follows the surrounding text color.

label-width.title: Label, icon and width
label-width.description: A visible label (attribute or slot), an icon slot, a custom width, full width, and a decorative indicator inside a button.

determinate.title: Determinate
determinate.description: value, max and show-value turn the bar and circle into determinate indicators; the format JS property customizes the text.

slots.label: Visible label (alternative to the label attribute).
